tools.name: ask_site
tools.description: Answer a visitor's question about eSIM Connect's travel eSIM catalog, coverage, plan data and validity, purchasing, wallet top-ups, accounts, or order management from the site's own content. Use when the visitor asks for site information rather than requesting a catalog search or account action. Returns matching content sections and source paths, or an explicit no-match note.

query.description: The visitor question about the site

tools.name: get_esim_plan_details
tools.description: Get the current details for one eSIM plan, including destination, data, validity, speed, coverage, price, and supported locations. Use when a visitor asks for more information about a specific plan before purchasing. Returns the plan details and source.

planId.description: The plan package code, id, or slug

tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Search the site's current travel eSIM catalog by destination, region, plan name, data allowance, or validity. Use when a visitor wants to find plans before opening a country page or starting a purchase. Returns matching plan summaries with identifiers, pricing, coverage, and destination paths; it does not purchase a plan.

query.description: Destination, region, plan name, data, or validity to search for

tools.name: start_esim_checkout
tools.description: Start secure checkout for a single-country eSIM plan and its quantity. Use after choosing a plan when the visitor is ready to pay; sign-in is required and this hands off to the site's own Stripe checkout without charging the payment in this call. Returns the checkout session and pending-payment status.

planId.description: The plan package code, id, or slug
